summary: Dependency-confusion probe beacons installer host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: npm package xblaxw@99.0.1 ships a postinstall hook (`node beacon.cjs`) and an `index.js` that both POST installer host identifiers (hostname, install path, cwd, Node version) to the hardcoded cleartext endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. The main module exports a Proxy that returns no-ops for every property access, and the package is published as a generic 'Compatibility shim.' at version 99.0.1 — the structural shape of a dependency-confusion probe designed to win resolution against an internal package name and report back when it is installed inside a build. The beacon fires both at `npm install` time via the postinstall script and on `require()` of the module, sending installer-side reconnaissance data to a bare-IP destination unrelated to any publisher, over plain HTTP with no user configuration.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
